product.name: Dragonz Land Trading Card Game
product.description: A blockchain-based play-to-earn trading card game where players collect cards, build decks, and battle others to earn $DRAGONZ tokens.

product.name: $DRAGONZ Token
product.description: The native cryptocurrency token used within Dragonz Land for earning, staking, and rewards.

product.name: Seasonal Tournaments
product.description: Competitive seasonal events where players battle to earn rewards, climb ranks, and win exclusive prizes.

product.name: Card Collection
product.description: A system for acquiring and managing various cards including Heroes, Champions, Spells, and Items used in gameplay.

product.name: Real-time PvP Battles
product.description: Player versus player battles conducted in real-time where players use their decks to compete for rewards and ranking.
